title: Note
description: note/v2: the document termination and trade-blocked carry. The guards decide both from the log; the document is a free-text reason for the audit trail, and on trade-blocked also the step a router could not take.

step.description: On trade-blocked: the step the router could not take (the reactor's step name).

code.description: On trade-blocked: a stable code for the reason, for machines to match (settlement-time-passed: the receiver refuses a late trade before any line is posted, and the booker may withdraw it).

collateralAccount.description: On trade-blocked: what the collateral account reported when the collateral platform refused the pledger's basket token issue (the ratio it fell short at), when the platform answered one.

status.description: The account's status as the platform reported it (e.g. ACTIVE).

ratio.description: Collateral value over liability, after haircuts, as the platform computed it, as a decimal string.

txHashes.description: The transactions that counted the collateral to the borrower.
